race.description: Geelong Cup On Sale Now F&M (Bm56) Hcp
race.comment: Siding with SOMERSAULT (4) in the last for the Begg yard. She was a smart maiden winner at this track first up, perhaps not handling the synthetic surface at Ballarat last time when right in the market. Back onto turf here, she'll bounce out and roll forward and should take catching from there. XTRAMAGIC (8) was a handy winner two back at Bendigo in easier, good again last time at Murray Bridge in this grade. She'll take holding out again. ANIA (1) is racing in fine form this time in, getting home strongly at big odds at Sale last start for second. Comes back a notch now and looks nicely placed. TUXEDO MISS (12) got off the mark two starts back over 1200m at Hamilton before finishing second last time over 1200m at Hamilton. Can feature.
